title: OpenIdentityPlatform OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an open redirect because WS-Federation logout, SAML v2.0 logout and…
description: OpenIdentityPlatform OpenAM versions before 16.1.4 contain an open redirect vulnerability. This occurs because certain logout and authentication pages do not validate destination URLs against an allowed list, enabling attackers to craft links that redirect users to arbitrary external sites, potentially facilitating phishing attacks. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.7.
